name: Minano (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minano town emblem in red: a ring with four short spokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Minano, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1973.

features.role: Minano town emblem — a ring with four short spokes enclosing a stylised character
